final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), above_average AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM above_average WHERE share > average_share
